subject: Dedicated capacity: technical deep-dive & sizing — next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: Dedicated capacity: technical deep-dive & sizing — recap + next steps

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned and can move to a technical deep-dive / capacity-sizing session:  

Summary of needs (from call):
- Peak throughput: ~100–150 req/s (you mentioned bursty traffic during settlement windows)
- Latency target: p95 <= 250ms for inference
- Typical request: ~3k–6k token context, mostly text-only
- Preference for hosted dedicated capacity in us-east-1 and VPC peering for private traffic

Suggested next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive & capacity-sizing call with our Solutions Engineer (Rishi) to walk expected traffic patterns, workload variance, and recommended instance classes/configs. On that call we will:
- Validate concurrency and sequence-length distribution
- Work through batching and KV-cache options
- Produce an initial sizing estimate + follow-up MAP (Mutual Action Plan)

Availability (ET):
- Tue 2026-10-06: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu 2026-10-08: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00

Prep items for the call (attached): sizing-prep-questions.docx (short questionnaire) and a one-page discovery-notes.pdf I pulled from today’s meeting. Can you:  
1) Confirm which internal folks will join (engineer(s), network/infra contact, procurement if required)
2) Confirm one or two candidate times above that work for your team

I’ll draft the calendar invite and include the agenda and a short pre-read.  

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Attach: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF), sizing-prep-questions.docx (DOCX)

Hi Camila —

Appreciate the summary and the clear next steps. Priya (cc’d) is our infra lead and should join the deep-dive. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock a time:  

- Peak numbers: we saw ~120 req/s during last month’s batch settlement window, with short bursts up to ~200 req/s for a 3–5 minute window.
- Latency: our hard p95 SLA is 200ms for inference (we can tolerate slightly higher cold-starts but want steady-state <=200ms).
- Payloads: median ~2.5k tokens, ~5% of requests exceed 4k tokens.
- Region: yes, prefer us-east-1 (multi-AZ).

Availability (ET) that works for us: Tue 2026-10-06 10:00–11:00 or Thu 2026-10-08 09:30–10:30. We’ll bring Priya and our Platform Eng lead (Anil Kumar). Attaching a network diagram for context.

Jordan
VP Product, Acme Payments
